IDN36631
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Minor Flood Warning for the Warrego River (NSW)

at Barringun and Enngonia

Issued at 12:39 pm Australian Eastern Daylight Time on Tuesday 3 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 3


MINOR FLOOD PEAK EXPECTED AT BARRINGUN ON WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON
MINOR FLOODING POSSIBLE AT ENNGONIA FROM THURSDAY

A flood peak from rain over the previous week in the Warrego Catchment in Queensland is
now causing stream rises at Barringun where minor flooding is occurring. Further
downstream, minor flooding possible at Enngonia from Thursday.

Warrego River (NSW):
Minor flooding is occurring along the Warrego River at Barringun No. 2 and possible at
Enngonia.

The Warrego River at Barringun No. 2 is currently at 3.00 m and steady, with minor
flooding. The Warrego River at Barringun No. 2 may reach around 3.20 m Wednesday
afternoon, with minor flooding.

No observations are currently available for the Warrego River at Enngonia. The river level
is estimated to be below the minor flood level (2.00 m) and steady. The Warrego River at
Enngonia may reach around the minor flood level (2.00 m) during Thursday, as upstream
flows arrive.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.ses.nsw.gov.au.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 01:00 PM AEDT on Wednesday 04 November 2026.

Latest River Heights:
Location                                    River Height   Tendency Time of Observation
Warrego River at Barringun No. 2              3.00 m       Steady   12:00 pm Tue 03/11/26
Warrego River at Enngonia
Warrego River at Fords Bridge Bywash          0.19 m       Steady   12:00 pm Tue 03/11/26

This advice is also available by dialling 1300 659 219. Warning, rainfall and river
information are available at http://www.bom.gov.au/australia/flood.
